data.narrative:
Nominal is a Series B-2 stage AI & Software company with a current valuation of $1B and $155M in total capital raised. The peer universe in AI & Software comprises 11 same-sector entities, including 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers such as Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

A peer-median approach was not applicable given insufficient datapoints within narrow filtering criteria. The analysis identified 2 similar-tier peers but requires a minimum of 3 comparables to establish statistical validity within the same-stage and adjacent-stage buckets. Attempting to rely on an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity, as stage, capital intensity, and revenue maturity vary substantially across the broader AI & Software landscape.

The current $1B valuation reflects a 6.5x multiple of total capital deployed. Given the stage and available comp universe, this valuation sits within defensible ranges but cannot be triangulated to a narrow band without either (1) expanding the peer set to include looser stage filters or (2) obtaining revenue and profitability data from the broader private peer group. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate and unit economics relative to Palantir and the five largest private peers. A more robust triangulation would require minimum three same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints with normalized revenue multiples.
